responsibility: This file owns creation of backend declarations and complete function bodies for the gfortran GENERIC translation phase. It builds FUNCTION_DECLs, RESULT_DECLs, local/module/global VAR_DECLs, runtime-library function declarations, coarray and IEEE support hooks, and module/block-data output; then it assembles translated procedure bodies with initialization, cleanup, deferred-variable handling, nested-function context management, cgraph registration, debug info emission, and main-program wrapping, turning resolved Fortran namespaces and symbols into backend-visible declarations ready for later compilation stages.
